title: docs(os-dev): the report comment opens with the seat signature, os-dev-report on line 2
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DWHWAYmZVGjAvyE1PE5yCN5)_

Fixes #27962

## What changes

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` lines 17–18, the two sentences that place the `os-dev-report` comment's lines. They now say the comment is written by `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, line 1 is the seat signature, and line 2 is the plain-text `os-dev-report` marker. The rest of the file is untouched; no recogniser changes (`post-stamped.mjs` and every first-line reader already skip one leading signature line through `stripSignatureLine` / `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER`).

## Why

Two governed texts contradicted each other. `os-dev.md:17` told a dev to open the report comment with `os-dev-report` on line 1, while `post-stamped.mjs` (the only sanctioned writer) refuses any body whose first line is not the seat signature (`LANE#N · ACCOUNT · SESSION`). Four devs reported the conflict; each dispatch paid a round trip. Triage 6516073129 ruled: signature on line 1, marker on line 2, name `post-stamped.mjs` as the writer, no recogniser change.

## Verification

- `os-dev.md` stays at 402 lines (its skill-line-ratchet ceiling); both replaced lines are 114 and 116 bytes.
- Readers accepting the line-2 form, measured on `origin/main` `6d5c021d9`: `check-half-states.mjs` `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` (optional leading `SEAT_SIGNATURE_SOURCE` line), `check-handover.mjs` `reportedStatus` (uses that marker), `check-prior-rulings.mjs` `classifyRulingComment` (calls `stripSignatureLine`).
- Every gate family `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this path was run locally with exit codes recorded and reconciled with `--ran`; the set is identical before and after the commit. Results are in the `os-dev-report` comment on the card.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os-dev.md` 第 17–18 行两句话,改为「报告评论由 `post-stamped.mjs` 写,首行席位签名,次行 `os-dev-report`」。
- 为什么改:原文说标记在首行,而唯一写入工具要求首行是签名,每次派发 dev 都要为此回一趟。
- 风险与回滚:纯规则文字,不碰任何识别器或门禁;回滚即 revert 这一个提交。
- 先看:diff 只有两行;对照 `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` 头注「The first line is the seat's signature」。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 与 `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` 绿;`wc -l .claude/agents/os-dev.md` 仍为 402。
- 需要你做的:暂无;契约复审(contract review)欠席位出具,落地档位以登记册为准(`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr`)。

[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (prose-only diff; derived lint families green)

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (nothing publishes; `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 block is the sanctioned Chinese channel)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
